mood: Elite, professional, precise, cinematic. Blends high-end luxury aesthetics with data-driven technical precision.

headings.sizes: H1: text-5xl sm:text-6xl+ | H2: text-3xl sm:text-4xl | H3: text-xl sm:text-2xl
headings.rules: Never use Inter for headings. Use Cormorant Garamond for a luxury editorial feel. Must use tight letter spacing.

colors.rules: No pure black #000000. No full-screen gradients. Use deep obsidian with gold accents. Buttons use accent color sparingly.

visual_enhancers.textures: Use background noise/grain overlay (opacity 3-5%) to remove digital flatness.
visual_enhancers.surfaces: Use Glassmorphism (Crystal/Apple variant: bg-black/60, backdrop-blur-xl, 1px border-white/10, shadow-lg) for sticky headers, floating navs, and premium project cards.
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid borders using white/10 or gold/20.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Ambient diffuse shadows for glass elements.

layouts.hero: Full screen (min-h-screen). 3D Avatar as centerpiece. Asymmetric text placement. Floating action bar at bottom for Contact/Resume.
layouts.grid: Bento Grid Protocol. Use grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12. Generous gaps (gap-8).
layouts.spacing: Generous spacing. py-24 or py-32 for sections. Container padding p-6 or p-8.
layouts.header: Sticky nav, z-50, Glassmorphism background. NEVER fully transparent.
layouts.footer: Massive footer, py-32. Big typography CTA.

motion.interactions: Hover states must explicitly set text color and background. Micro-interactions on buttons (scale 0.98 on tap, translate-y on hover). Staggered entrance for lists/grids.

3d_libraries.usage: Use Spline for the 3D Avatar centerpiece in the Hero section. It provides an interactive, 'designer-first' 3D experience. For data visualization in projects, use Recharts.

component_guidelines.file_type: MUST USE .js FILES! DO NOT USE .tsx!
component_guidelines.buttons: Pill-shaped or slightly rounded. Hover states must have higher contrast.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure minimum 4.5:1 ratio for normal text. Use APCA guidelines.
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.

instructions_to_main_agent: You MUST write React components using .js files ONLY. Do not use .tsx files.
Apply 'Luxury Dark' aesthetic. Backgrounds should be very dark gray/obsidian (#050505, #0a0a0c) with subtle noise texture. NO full-page gradients.
Use glassmorphism (backdrop-blur, translucent bg, 1px bright border) for headers, cards, and overlays. DO NOT use completely transparent backgrounds for anything content-bearing (like the header).
Use framer-motion for smooth staggered list reveals and hover animations.
For the 3D Hero Avatar, use @splinetool/react-spline. Embed a public Spline URL or placeholder 3D scene if specific model isn't available, ensuring it responds to cursor movement.
All buttons, inputs, and interactive elements MUST have a data-testid attribute.
Contact links: Ensure WhatsApp link uses 'https://wa.me/...' format, Email uses 'mailto:...', and Phone uses 'tel:...'.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Avoid generic 'AI slop' aesthetics. Do not center-align the app container. Create depth with layered elements and z-index hierarchy. Ensure interactive elements have distinct hover/focus states with higher contrast. Do NOT use universal transitions (transition: all). Use specific transitions (e.g., transition-colors, transition-transform). Never use AI assistant emojis. Missing categories must not use placeholder text.
